name: content-writer
description: Content-build write stage: transforms fetched source markdown (and drafts generate-pages) into final Joomla-ready article HTML per the Solutio house style. Runs per batch in a fresh context window on the Claude Agent SDK. Writes one HTML file per entry to the site workspace and returns only a compact status JSON — page content never flows through the caller's context. The harness (not this agent) stamps content_file/draft/status into the schematic.
